item.title: Gym Promo With Visit Details

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

answer_sheet.Business name and address: Northside Gym; 18 Cedar Road. Do not add a city, postcode or other contact details.
answer_sheet.Text timing: Show the name, address and both hours lines together throughout the last 5 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, readable on a phone.
answer_sheet.Visuals and style: A welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding. Specific scene, colours and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Upbeat music, no voiceover. English text.

must_haves: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.
After the follow-up, the final result is widescreen 16:9 (the user changed the shape from vertical 9:16); everything else is as before.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt:
Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 local gym promotional video for Northside Gym, designed for viewing on a phone. Friendly, welcoming, bright neighborhood fitness space, natural daylight, warm colors, approachable adult gym members with varied body types and fitness levels wearing modest ordinary workout clothing. Gentle exercise and friendly smiles, light dumbbells and stretching, no hardcore bodybuilding, no intimidating weightlifting, no shirtless people. Smooth slow camera movement. TIMING: seconds 0–5 show an inviting wide view of the gym with adults exercising casually and a friendly trainer welcoming a member. Seconds 5–10: transition to a clean, stable promotional end card over a softly blurred and darkened gym background. Keep ALL FOUR of the following text lines visible TOGETHER, continuously for the ENTIRE final five seconds, from exactly 5.0 seconds to 10.0 seconds. Render exact text, no extra wording:
Northside Gym
18 Cedar Road
Mon–Fri 6am–10pm
Sat–Sun 8am–6pm
Use very large bold clean sans-serif lettering in white, high contrast against a deep navy darkened background, centered, generous line spacing, all text comfortably inside phone-safe margins. Gym name largest; address and opening hours also large and clearly readable on a phone. No scrolling, no sequential line reveals, no changing wording, no disappearing text, no text movement during the final five seconds. AUDIO: upbeat friendly instrumental pop music with a light energetic beat, no vocals, absolutely no voiceover or speech. Finish neatly at 10 seconds.
